title: DWG TEXT active alignment single-elevation loss guard
authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 section 20.4.3 p.111-112 defines one elevation and two 2D TEXT points. Autodesk DXF TEXT groups 10 and 11 are OCS points.
producer_provenance: ezdxf 1.4.5 authored local AC1027 DXFs using tools/author_text_alignment_elevation.py; ODA File Converter 27.1 converted to AC1027 DWG and AC1027 DXF. The physical input/output pairing is the recorded local conversion lineage, not authenticated by the auditor. No ODA .err files were observed.
findings: For active HCenter/VMiddle text, original insertion (1,2,3) and alignment (4,5,7), ODA source stores elevation 7 and returns both Z values 7; baseline libdxfrw AC1021 stores elevation 3 and returns both 3. For matching-Z control both preserve 3. The same source result holds for normal (0,1,0), where the alignment WCS point is (-4,7,5) rather than (-4,3,5). The baseline same/mismatch AC1021 DWGs have identical SHA-256. LibreDWG 0.14 confirms each selected wire elevation and XY pair; ezdxf verifies DXF fields and selected WCS geometry.
scope: Exact built-in TEXT facade preflight latches failure for active alignment with nonzero unequal second Z or nonfinite active elevation; inherited Point/Line facade entries share the guard. The base TEXT codec also refuses before mutating buffers. The legacy zero second Z is interpreted as unspecified, so a deliberate distinct zero is not representable or detected. Left/baseline (inactive alignment) retains existing behavior even with unequal Z. Consumer-defined subclasses using a custom codec remain unchanged; subclasses that invoke base codec can still have ignored false results under old caller policy. ATTRIB, ATTDEF, MTEXT and other built-in codecs remain out of scope.
compatibility: No DRW_Interface or public object layout change. LibreCAD uses XY for geometry and keeps both original 3D points in its sidecar; LibreCAD_3 consumes the insertion coordinate. Matching-Z, unspecified zero, tilted normal, all active horizontal and vertical modes, inactive alignment, custom overridden 3D codec and six supported writer revisions have focused controls.
validation: Six-version fixture-free CTest passes. Direct codec invalid-value controls preserve partial-bit cursor; full-file ignored-return controls preserve destination sentinel and caller handle, with corrected same-writer retry through writeText/writePoint/writeLine. Selected matching-Z and zero-unspecified read back through native reader. Peer audit passes all four producer source/DWG/return cases and the generated AC1021 baseline loss case under python -O. This is selected TEXT geometry, not general whole-file or native CAD support.
